name: Error Triage - Get Errors API (v2 - Circuit Breaker + Push)

assignments.name: rawError
assignments.value: ={{JSON.stringify($json.data && $json.data.resultData && $json.data.resultData.error ? $json.data.resultData.error : {message: 'No error detail returned by /executions for this run.'})}}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-sonnet-5", max_tokens: 150, messages: [ { role: "user", content: "Translate this workflow error into ONE short, plain-English sentence a non-engineer could understand. Name the likely service and cause if identifiable (e.g. 'HubSpot rate limit exceeded'). Do not repeat the raw error text. Error: " + $json.rawError } ] }) }}

assignments.name: node
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { return JSON.parse($('Shape Execution Fields').item.json.rawError).node?.name || 'Unknown node'; } catch(e) { return 'Unknown node'; } })() }}
